item.title: A message from Write to Right:
item.description: Hey STA! On December 10th, our school will join millions of people around the world for Amnesty International's Write for Rights campaign. This global event encourages people to write letters for individuals whose human rights are being violated. Together our letters can pressure governments to release prisoners, protect activists, and change unjust laws. This year, Owen Chow from Hong Kong is one of many people who we are helping. He stood up for democracy, despite the risk in his country. At the early age of 15, he dedicated his life to serve the underprivileged and build a fairer society. Owen was arrested in 2021 and sentenced to more than 12 years in prison. Let's help call on Hong Kong authorities to immediately release Owen. Keep an eye out for posters around the school to learn how you can take part and help make a difference.
